description: Target metrics for full-domain maneuver mastery. The auto_train_loop checks all thresholds; training continues until ALL are met or max iterations reached.

waypoint_definitions.level_1: Gentle turns (±30° heading, level flight, 200 m/s)
waypoint_definitions.level_3: Large turns + bank (180° heading, 20° pitch, ±45° roll, 250 m/s)
waypoint_definitions.level_4: Aggressive pitch + roll (45° pitch, ±60° roll, 200-280 m/s)

notes.full_domain_definition: Agent can reliably reach and hold targets across the full attitude envelope: pitch [-70°, +70°], roll [-180°, +180°], heading [0°, 360°], speed [80, 400] m/s
notes.success_criteria: Waypoint is 'reached' when attitude error ≤ 10° AND speed error ≤ 15 m/s, sustained for ≥ 30 decision steps (~6 seconds at 5 Hz)
notes.curriculum_mapping: Evaluation levels 1-5 roughly correspond to training curriculum levels 0-1, 2-3, 4-5, 6, 7
